title: Parathyroidectomy in primary hyperparathyroidism: operate if symptomatic, or if any one criterion is met - PTH damage to the kidney or to bone, or age under 50
root: Parathyroidectomy if symptomatic, or ANY ONE of:

drugs.name: Serum calcium > 0.25 mmol/L above the upper limit
T-score < −2.5
drugs.agents: lumbar spine, femoral neck, total hip or one-third radius
